stem.text: Which compound will produce a yellow-orange precipitate when added to 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine?

A.alt: Skeletal structure of cyclohexene: a six-membered ring with one C=C double bond.

B.alt: Skeletal structure of a six-membered cyclic ester (lactone) with a C=O group.

C.alt: Skeletal structure of cyclohexanecarboxylic acid: a cyclohexane ring bonded to a COOH group.

D.alt: Skeletal structure of cyclohexanone: a six-membered carbon ring with a C=O group.
